sfc_structure.component: root — the SFC file; emits a Class symbol (isVueComponent/isSfc)
sfc_structure.template_element: template block — component usages -> instantiates; v-if/v-for/v-show -> template decision points
sfc_structure.script_element: script block — delegated to the JS/TS sub-analyzer (engine-provided sfcScriptTrees)

template.element: instantiates (non-builtin tag, isComponentUsage) — leaf tag name as written
template.interpolation: {{ expr }} — template expression (gap V2: no Uses to script members)

script.defineProps: Property symbols from object form ({ size: Number }) OR generic type-literal form (<{ id: string }>) — generic form is gap V1
script.defineEmits: Event symbols from array form (['change']) OR generic call-signature form (<{ (e: 'save'): void }>) — generic form is gap V1
script.vue_options_component: options-object component symbol (name: option) + props/emits/data/methods via extractOptionsApi

expressions_requiring_uses_or_calls: interpolation {{ count }} — template member use (gap V2)
directive value expressions :label=@click=v-model — template member use (gap V2)
script expressions — delegated to JS/TS analyzer (calls/uses/references)
statements_affecting_complexity: template directives: v-if / v-else-if / v-for / v-show
_notes: Vue SFC = template + script + style; the script is parsed by the JS/TS sub-analyzer, so script-side edges (imports/calls/uses/references/contains/exports/extends/overrides) follow those analyzers.
Component usages in template are instantiates (usage_contextual); builtin HTML + Vue tags filtered.
The component symbol (moduleName or name: option) is the SFC's Class; props/emits are Property/Event symbols owned by it.
